title: Angel Stadium Transportation | Limo & Party Bus Game Day
description: Game day at Angel Stadium? Compare limo, SUV, and party bus options, plus drop-off, pickup, timing, and the real parking math for Los Angeles Angels games.
h1: Getting to Angel Stadium: Drop-Off, Parking and the Ride Home

blocks.text: Book a luxury SUV for two to six people, a stretch limo or Sprinter for six to fourteen, and a party bus for anything past that. Then agree on a pickup spot before you go in, because the difference between a good Angels game and a bad one is usually the 45 minutes after the final out.

blocks.text: Angel Stadium holds around 45,000 people, and a good chunk of them leave through the same few exits at the same moment. Parking is one line. Rideshare is another. A pre-arranged car with a driver who knows the lots is a third.

blocks.text: Why Driving Yourself Is the Weakest Plan

The stadium sits between the 57 freeway and Katella Avenue, which is convenient right up until 9:30 PM. Then the parking lots drain onto the same streets, and the backup runs from Gene Autry Way to State College Boulevard.
blocks.html: The stadium sits between the 57 freeway and Katella Avenue, which is convenient right up until 9:30 PM. Then the parking lots drain onto the same streets, and the backup runs from Gene Autry Way to State College Boulevard.

items: General parking typically runs around $20 and the lots fill early on giveaway nights.
Leaving the lot can take 20 to 40 minutes before you even reach a freeway.
Rideshare surge after a close game is real, and the pickup zone moves.
If you are drinking, driving is not an option, and that is the whole conversation.

blocks.text: The Drop-Off and Pickup Plan

This is the part that decides your night. The stadium has three car entrances (Douglass Road, State College Boulevard, and Orangewood Avenue), but buses and oversized vehicles use Orangewood only. Pregame drop-off for those vehicles runs through the Orangewood Bus and VIP Entrance.

blocks.text: Postgame is different. Rideshare pickup is in the lot directly in front of Gate 1, near the City National Grove of Anaheim. It is not at the drop-off lane, and it is not at the home plate gate. That one detail is why so many groups spend 15 minutes walking a 12,500-space lot in the dark.

items: Get dropped at the gate closest to your seats. The Big A side and the home plate side are different walks.
Pick a pickup point before the game, not after. A named corner or lot entrance beats "out front."
Text the driver when the game is in the eighth inning. He can stage before the crowd hits the street.
If your group is slow, agree on a 15-minute grace window. Waiting at the curb is what turns a good night sour.
For day games, sunscreen and water in the car. For night games, a jacket. Sounds trivial until you are the one who forgot.

blocks.text: We stage drivers near the stadium before the final out, not after. That single habit saves 20 minutes on the way home.

blocks.text: When to Arrive and When to Leave
Gates generally open about 90 minutes before first pitch, and the first hour is the calm one. Arriving early means shorter food lines, a chance to watch batting practice, and no scramble at the gate.
blocks.html: Gates generally open about 90 minutes before first pitch, and the first hour is the calm one. Arriving early means shorter food lines, a chance to watch batting practice, and no scramble at the gate.

blocks.text: Leaving is a choice. You can beat the crowd by leaving after the seventh-inning stretch, or you can stay for the final out and accept a 20-minute wait. What you should not do is leave in the eighth and then stand on the curb wondering where the car is. Tell the driver your plan and he will match it.

blocks.text: The Cost Math

Four friends, one game, one night. Two rideshares each way at surge pricing can run $80 to $120 total. Parking plus gas plus the risk of one person staying sober runs about $35. A stretch limo split four ways for a four-hour minimum lands in the same neighborhood as the rideshares, with none of the waiting.

A stretch limo split four ways for a four-hour minimum lands in the same neighborhood as the rideshares, with none of the waiting.

blocks.text: For groups of ten or more, the math usually favors a bus or a large limo outright. That is before you count the fact that everyone arrives together and nobody has to find parking.

blocks.text: Rates vary by date, vehicle, and demand. Opening Day, playoff games, and weekends cost more than a Tuesday in May. Ask for the quote in writing with the minimum and the overtime rate included.

blocks.text: A Season That Starts Before Opening Day

The Angels play from April into the fall, and the stadium hosts concerts and events outside the season. If you are planning a group outing for next season, the smart move is to book the vehicle before the schedule fills up. Prom season, wedding season, and baseball season all compete for the same Saturday nights in Orange County.

blocks.text: Frequently Asked Questions
Can a limo drop off at Angel Stadium?
Yes, at the passenger drop-off areas outside the gates. The driver will confirm the closest accessible point for your gate and agree on a pickup spot before you go in.
blocks.html: Yes, at the passenger drop-off areas outside the gates. The driver will confirm the closest accessible point for your gate and agree on a pickup spot before you go in.

blocks.text: How much is parking at Angel Stadium?

items: General parking is $25 at the gate or $27 online. Preferred is $35 ($37 online).
The lot opens 2.5 hours before first pitch and closes one hour after the game.
No in-and-out. Once you are in, you are in for the night.
Alcohol is not allowed in the stadium lots, even if you arrive by bus.

blocks.text: What is the best way to get to an Angels game with a group?

One vehicle for the whole group. An SUV for four, a stretch limo or Sprinter for up to 14, and a party bus above that. It removes parking, surge pricing, and the designated-driver problem in one move.
blocks.html: One vehicle for the whole group. An SUV for four, a stretch limo or Sprinter for up to 14, and a party bus above that. It removes parking, surge pricing, and the designated-driver problem in one move.

blocks.text: Can we tailgate before the game?

Stadium lots allow tailgating within their rules, usually in designated areas and without open flames. If you want the party to start in the vehicle, book the party bus and tailgate at your destination.
blocks.html: Stadium lots allow tailgating within their rules, usually in designated areas and without open flames. If you want the party to start in the vehicle, book the party bus and tailgate at your destination.

blocks.text: How early should we book game-day transportation?
Two to four weeks for a regular game. Opening Day, playoff games, and any weekend series sell out faster, so book six to eight weeks ahead if you can.
blocks.html: Two to four weeks for a regular game. Opening Day, playoff games, and any weekend series sell out faster, so book six to eight weeks ahead if you can.

blocks.text: Where is rideshare pickup after an Angels game?
In the parking lot directly in front of Gate 1, near the City National Grove of Anaheim. Look for the rideshare signs. Pregame drop-off uses the Orangewood entrance, which is a different spot.
blocks.html: In the parking lot directly in front of Gate 1, near the City National Grove of Anaheim. Look for the rideshare signs. Pregame drop-off uses the Orangewood entrance, which is a different spot.

blocks.text: What is the bag policy at Angel Stadium?
The stadium uses a clear-bag policy, and there is no bag check. Check the current size limits on the Angels site before you go, and leave anything that does not fit in the car.
blocks.html: The stadium uses a clear-bag policy, and there is no bag check. Check the current size limits on the Angels site before you go, and leave anything that does not fit in the car.

blocks.text: Can we tailgate in the stadium lot?

Yes, in general parking areas, with approved gas or propane grills. Charcoal is not allowed, alcohol is not allowed in the lots, and the vehicle cannot block a lane. If you want the party to start before the gate, a party bus is the easier version.

blocks.text: Do you drive to Angel Stadium from Los Angeles or Newport Beach?
Yes. We pick up across Orange County and Los Angeles, including hotels, homes, and John Wayne Airport.

blocks.text: Bottom Line
The game is three hours. The traffic around it can be another hour if you improvise. Book the car, pick the gate, agree on the corner, and let the night end on a good note.
